svg.text: Taste for Petri, 2026-11-15: what moved and what didn't

Dots = paired mean change, lines = 90% CI (bootstrap over 10-11 seeds). A line that doesn't cross 0 is significant. Colours: haiku judge/target (blue), GPT-6 Sol judge (red), Kimi K2.6 target (green).

Green = real use, orange = our audits, red = benchmarks. Room left for agentic audits: ~0.03 (0.93 → 0.90).
